title.narrative: UniCredit Mortgage Bank: covered bonds investment

description.narrative: In September 2023, the EBRD invested in two covered bond issuances of UniCredit Mortgage Bank ("UCBM"): HUF 5 billion (€12.9 million) in a green covered bond, as part of HUF 20 billion green covered bond issuance, and HUF 6 billion (€15.5 million) in a regular covered bond, as part of HUF 23.2 billion regular covered bond issuance. The bonds are rated A1 by Moody's and listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange. These investments have been preceded by three investments made throughout 2020, in particular: (i) HUF 4.5 million (€11.6 million) investment in March 2020, (ii) HUF 1.5 billion (€3.9 million) in June 2020 and (iii) HUF 2.9 billion (€7.4 million) in November 2020 for an aggregate investment of HUF 8.9 billion (€22.8 million) in regular covered bonds that were listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange. With this transaction the EBRD aims to support covered bond issuances of UCMB to facilitate its mortgage lending activities and optimise the funding structure through long-term funding instruments. Furthermore, EBRD promotes resource efficiency in the country by requiring Unicredit Hungary (the parent company of UCMB) to invest an amount corresponding to at least 100 per cent of the EBRD's investment in non-green/regular covered bonds to finance green investments in renewable energy projects and/or residential building sectors.
